<page>
 Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
 Pearland, TX
 Phone 346-555-7901
 Letter of Representation
October 6, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1184
Our client: David Fernandez
Date of loss: September 6, 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our
client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether
by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of the insured has already been in contact with our client,
please let us know so that we may address it.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver, along with a
copy of the declarations page for each policy. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage
exists.
Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or
surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any claim file materials. Destruction
or alteration of such material could result in serious consequences for your insured and for the carrier. We look forward to your
prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Andrew Lewis
Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
